name: Medical Researcher
gmNotes: Medical Researcher is a profession Archetype. Banshees work as medical researchers and scanners, so a typical Banshee carries both Banshee (fey-role) and Medical Researcher (profession). Research covers anatomy, psychology, imprinting, attachment, epidemic investigation, and environmental contamination. Sonic comb scanners and reagent analytic sheets are tools of the profession, not innate Banshee powers. The Archetype grants no automatic mechanics.
description: A healer of the hidden sort — one who studies bodies, minds, and what makes people what they are. Medical researchers ask the questions the village would rather not hear answered, and their findings rarely stay in the clinic.
